author_rationale: Identity migration: 'before re-derivation, references of q are rewritten through this map'; one successor = rename. R009's reference to Prop_Route is rewritten to Prop_AdministrationRoute, which exists and is owned by D001 -> O5 passes -> R009 stays accepted. O2: EHR_System no longer holds Action_QueryDatabase, performed by R007 -> fail -> rejected (H_f precedes the open U001). Other base requirements are unaffected (D001 keeps its other properties; the Nurse is not referenced). RX08: Nurse participates (responsible for G003 in L), holds the action, but has no authorityLevel -> O3 fail -> rejected. RX09: I002's source is EHR_System, not the expected Pharmacist -> O6 fail -> rejected (C004 unchecked is dominated). RX10: all hard obligations hold (C002 passes on authority in X002, C001 not triggered), the declared soft C003 has no validator -> reservation -> accepted with reservations.
